_comment: GitHub Copilot AI-credit rates, USD per 1M tokens (1 AI credit = $0.01). Source: docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/models-and-pricing. rates = [input, cached input, cache write, output]; long_rates apply when the request's context (input + cached + cache write) exceeds long_threshold. promos scale a model's credits by factor before 'until' (UTC). Models missing here fall back to OpenCode's own dollar cost.
